The team, also unofficially nicknamed the "Zags", was led by head coach [[Mark Few]], in his 25th season as head coach, and played home games at the on-campus [[McCarthey Athletic Center]] as members of the [[West Coast Conference]] (WCC). They finished the season 27–8, 14–2 in [[2023–24 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC play]] to finish in second place, failing to win at least a share of the regular season title for the first time since [[2011–12 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|2012]]. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2024 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC Tournament]], they defeated [[2023–24 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|San Francisco]] in the semifinals, before losing to [[2023–24 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]] in the championship. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA Tournament]] where as the No. 5 seed in the Midwest region, they defeated [[2023–24 McNeese Cowboys basketball team|McNeese]] in the First Round and [[2023–24 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] in the Second Round to reach their ninth consecutive Sweet Sixteen, where they lost to [[2023–24 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Purdue]]. == Previous season == {{Main|2022–23 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team}} The [[2022–23 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 31–6, 14–2 in [[2022–23 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC Play]] to win the regular season championship with [[2022–23 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]]. They defeated [[2022–23 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|San Francisco]] and [[2022–23 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]] in the [[2023 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] to win the tournament championship. As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 3 seed in the West region, where they defeated [[2022–23 Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball team|Grand Canyon]] in the first round, [[2022–23 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]] in the second round, [[2022–23 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]] in the sweet sixteen before losing to national champion [[2022–23 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]] in the elite eight. On January 19, 2023, the Zags lost to [[2022–23 Loyola Marymount Lions men's basketball team|Loyola Marymount]] at the McCarthey Athletic Center, ending their 76-game home winning streak, which was the longest in the nation at the time.{{Cite web |date=2023-01-20 |title=LMU halts Gonzaga's 76-game home win streak
